title: Step 4 - Train Neural Network: Compile & Fit for Customer Churn Prediction

cues.en: -: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: I'm sure you feel amazing after having built your very first artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 建立完第一個人工神經網路，你一定感覺很棒。

cues.en: But remember, that's only half part of the job.
cues.zh: 不過記得，這只完成一半工作。

cues.en: The second half will be of course to train it on the whole training set.
cues.zh: 另一半當然是使用完整訓練集來訓練它。

cues.en: And we are gonna do this in two steps.
cues.zh: 這分成兩個步驟。

cues.en: The first one is to compile the A and N with an optimizer a loss function, and a metric, which will be of course the accuracy because we're doing some classification.
cues.zh: 第一步，編譯 ANN，指定最佳化器、損失函數，以及評估指標。這裡是分類，所以指標當然選準確率。

cues.en: And then the second step will be, of course, to train the A and N on the training set over a certain number of epic.
cues.zh: 第二步，用訓練集訓練 ANN，進行一定數量的 epoch。

cues.en: Are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Starting with this first step, compiling the A and N.
cues.zh: 先從編譯 ANN 開始。

cues.en: All right, so once again doing this will be super simple thanks to the TensorFlow library that integrated carus because indeed, to compile our A and N
cues.zh: 因為 TensorFlow 整合了 Keras，所以這件事同樣很簡單。要編譯 ANN，

cues.en: we first need to start from our A and N object which I remind was created as an instance of the sequential class.
cues.zh: 先從 ann 物件開始，記得它是 Sequential 類別的實例。

cues.en: And then from this object, we're gonna call a new method which this time of course won't be the add method but can you actually guess what this method is gonna be?
cues.zh: 再透過這個物件呼叫新方法，這次當然不是 add。你猜是什麼？

cues.en: You know, there is no trap in TensorFlow, nor any confusion.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 沒有設陷阱，也不會故意造成混淆。

cues.en: Well, the method to compile an artificial neural network is simply the compile method, as simple as that, right?
cues.zh: 編譯人工神經網路的方法，就叫 compile，這麼簡單。

cues.en: We didn't even have to look at the TensorFlow documentation which by the way, I still recommend to have a look at because you will get a lot of information on the diverse tools you have in the TensorFlow library.
cues.zh: 甚至不需要查 TensorFlow 文件就能猜到。不過仍然建議看看文件，裡面有各種工具的大量資訊。

cues.en: But here, it's super intuitive, it's super easy.
cues.zh: 但這裡非常直覺、非常容易。

cues.en: So now I have a next question for you.
cues.zh: 接著再問你一個問題。

cues.en: According to you, what do we have to enter as parameters inside this compiled method?
cues.zh: 你認為 compile 裡面要傳入哪些參數？

cues.en: Well, I actually said it.
cues.zh: 其實我剛才說過了。

cues.en: We have to enter three parameters.
cues.zh: 需要三個參數。

cues.en: The first one is the optimizer to choose an optimizer.
cues.zh: 第一個是 optimizer，用來選擇最佳化器。

cues.en: Then the second one is the loss to choose a loss function.
cues.zh: 第二個是 loss，用來選擇損失函數。

cues.en: And the third one is the metrics with an S parameter.
cues.zh: 第三個是 metrics，注意最後有 s。

cues.en: Because know that you can actually choose several metrics to evaluate your A and N at the same time, but we will only choose one and we will choose the accuracy.
cues.zh: 因為可以同時選擇多個指標評估 ANN，但我們只選一個，也就是 accuracy。

cues.en: But there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: These are the three parameters.
cues.zh: 總共這三個參數。

cues.en: So I suggest that we start by entering them and then we'll enter their values.
cues.zh: 建議先把參數名稱寫好，再填入值。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start with the first one.
cues.zh: 先從第一個開始。

cues.en: Optimizer equals all.
cues.zh: 先寫 optimizer=。

cues.en: Then comma, the next one is the loss for the loss function.
cues.zh: 再加逗號，接著是指定損失函數的 loss。

cues.en: And finally, the third one is the metrics parameter.
cues.zh: 最後是 metrics。

cues.en: All right, so for the optimizer, which one would you like to get?
cues.zh: optimizer 應該選哪一個？

cues.en: Well, in the intuition lectures, Kirel mentioned that the best one are the optimizers that can perform stochastic gradient descent.
cues.zh: 直覺課程中，Kirill 提過，較好的最佳化器能執行隨機梯度下降。

cues.en: And the best of them, you know, the one that I recommend by default is the Atom Optimizer, which is a very performance optimizer that can perform stochastic gradient descent.
cues.zh: 其中我預設推薦 Adam，它是效能很好的最佳化器，能執行隨機梯度下降。

cues.en: And by that, let me just remind what stochastic gradient descent allows to do.
cues.zh: 先提醒一下隨機梯度下降的用途。

cues.en: Well, you know, it is what will update the weights in order to reduce the loss error between your predictions And the real results.
cues.zh: 它會更新權重，減少預測與真實結果之間的損失誤差。

cues.en: You know, when we train the A and N on the training set we will at each iteration compare the predictions in a batch to the real results in the same batch.
cues.zh: 用訓練集訓練 ANN 時，每次迭代都會比較同一批次中的預測與實際結果。

cues.en: And that optimizer here will update the weight through stochastic gradient descent because we're gonna choose the Atom optimizer to at the next iteration, hopefully reduce the loss.
cues.zh: 這裡選 Adam 最佳化器，透過隨機梯度下降更新權重，希望下一次迭代能降低損失。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So that's why right here we have to choose an optimizer but also a loss function, which is the way to compute the difference between the predictions and the real results, and then the accuracy of course
cues.zh: 所以必須選擇最佳化器，也要選損失函數，衡量預測與實際結果的差異；另外還要準確率，

cues.en: because that's our final evaluation metric.
cues.zh: 因為它是最後的評估指標。

cues.en: All right, so as we said we're gonna choose the atom optimizer, and the code name for that is simply, but with no capital letter atom. Okay, congratulations.
cues.zh: 照剛才所說選擇 Adam，程式代號就是全部小寫的 adam。恭喜。

cues.en: Now, you know how to compile an artificial neural network with an optimizer but then we also have to compile it with a loss function.
cues.zh: 現在你知道如何在編譯 ANN 時設定最佳化器，但也必須設定損失函數。

cues.en: And now you have to know something very important when you are doing binary classification.
cues.zh: 進行二元分類時，有一件非常重要的事。

cues.en: You know, classification when you have to predict a binary outcome.
cues.zh: 也就是需要預測二元結果的分類。

cues.en: Well, the loss function must always be the following one entered in quotes, of course which is binary underscore cross entropy, just like that.
cues.zh: 損失函數要使用引號中的 binary_crossentropy。

cues.en: And now let me tell you what you would have to enter if you were doing non-binary classification.
cues.zh: 再說明如果不是二元分類，應該填什麼。

cues.en: You know, like for example predicting three different categories while here you would have to enter a category called cross entropy loss okay? For binary classification
cues.zh: 例如預測三種不同類別，就使用 categorical_crossentropy。二元分類時，

cues.en: the loss must be binary cross entropy.
cues.zh: loss 使用 binary_crossentropy。

cues.en: And for non-binary classification the loss must be category call cross entropy.
cues.zh: 非二元分類則使用 categorical_crossentropy。

cues.en: And then also, you know when doing non-binary classification when predicting more than two categories while the activation should not be sigmoid, but soft max, right?
cues.zh: 另外，多類別分類、預測兩類以上時，輸出激活函數也不應是 sigmoid，而是 softmax。

cues.en: I take this opportunity to also give you the other cases of classification, which you could encounter.
cues.zh: 利用這個機會，一併介紹可能遇到的其他分類情況。

cues.en: Okay, so now you know everything.
cues.zh: 現在你都知道了。

cues.en: And then remember that for regression because we can also do artificial neural networks for regression, while we have this free course which I give you the link, you can just take this course
cues.zh: 記得，人工神經網路也可以做迴歸。我們另有免費課程，提供連結，你可以免費修課，

cues.en: for free and you will get the full implementation of an artificial neural network for a regression case study.
cues.zh: 取得用於迴歸案例的人工神經網路完整實作。

cues.en: So you have really everything that you can do with an artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 所以神經網路的各種用途都能學到。

cues.en: All right, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now let's enter the final parameter here.
cues.zh: 接著填入最後一個參數。

cues.en: Metrics, as I said we can actually choose several metrics at the same time.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，metrics 可以同時指定多個指標。

cues.en: Therefore, in order to enter the values of this parameter while we have to enter them in a pair of square bracket which is supposed to be, you know the list of the different metrics
cues.zh: 因此參數值必須放在中括號裡，作為不同評估指標的串列，

cues.en: with which you want to evaluate your A and N during the training, but we will only choose the main one.
cues.zh: 用來在訓練時評估 ANN。不過這裡只選最主要的，

cues.en: You know, the most essential one which is the accuracy and which you have to enter in quotes.
cues.zh: 也就是最基本的準確率，記得放在引號中。

cues.en: Alright, Accuracy, just like the classic spelling.
cues.zh: accuracy，使用一般的拼法。

cues.en: And now, now congratulations.
cues.zh: 現在，恭喜你。

cues.en: You know how to do a full compile of your A and N with an optimizer, a loss, and some metrics.
cues.zh: 你已經知道如何完整編譯 ANN，設定最佳化器、損失函數與評估指標。

cues.en: Perfect. So now let's move on to the ultimate step meaning the step where we will train the A and N onto the whole training set.
cues.zh: 很好。最後一步是用整個訓練集訓練 ANN。

cues.en: So let's create a new code cell.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And now, according to you how do we need to start this training?
cues.zh: 你認為要怎麼開始訓練？

cues.en: Well, once again, you know, it's always the same thing.
cues.zh: 同樣地，流程一直都一樣。

cues.en: We need to take our A and N object, then call a new method which will perform the training and then enter a couple of parameters.
cues.zh: 取得 ann 物件，呼叫負責訓練的新方法，再提供幾個參數。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's start with A and N first, our object.
cues.zh: 先寫 ann 物件。

cues.en: And then according to you, what will be the method that can train your artificial neural network on the training set?
cues.zh: 那要用哪個方法，在訓練集上訓練人工神經網路？

cues.en: Well, nothing has changed here.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有改變。

cues.en: And actually, I think I said it earlier in the course the method to train whatever machine learning model is always the same one.
cues.zh: 課程前面應該提過，訓練機器學習模型的方法名稱一直相同。

cues.en: It is the fit method.
cues.zh: 就是 fit。

cues.en: The fit method in which we'll take always the same parameters.
cues.zh: fit 也會使用相同的基本參數。

cues.en: The first one is X train for you know the matrix of features of the training set.
cues.zh: 第一個是 X_train，代表訓練集的特徵矩陣。

cues.en: Then Y train for the dependent variable vector of the training set?
cues.zh: 再來是 y_train，訓練集的應變數向量。

cues.en: And then when training an artificial neural network we actually need to enter two more parameters which are first the batch size.
cues.zh: 不過訓練人工神經網路還需要兩個參數，首先是 batch_size。

cues.en: Because indeed batch learning is always more efficient and more performance when training an artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 因為訓練神經網路時，批次學習的效率和效能比較好。

cues.en: Meaning that instead of comparing your prediction to the real result, one by one, you know to compute and reduce the loss, well you are gonna do that with several predictions compared
cues.zh: 也就是不要逐筆比較預測與真實結果來計算並降低損失，而是一次比較多個預測，

cues.en: to several real results into a batch.
cues.zh: 與同一批次的多個真實結果。

cues.en: And the batch size here, you know the batch size parameter gives exactly the number of predictions you want to have in the batch to be compared to that same number of real results.
cues.zh: batch_size 就是每批包含多少個預測，與相同數量的真實結果比較。

cues.en: And the classic value of the batch size that is usually chosen is 32, right?
cues.zh: 常見的批次大小是 32。

cues.en: If you don't want to spend too much time tuning this hyper parameter well I recommend to choose the default value 32.
cues.zh: 如果不想花太多時間調整這個超參數，建議先用預設值 32。

cues.en: But anyway, I wanted to highlight that hyper parameter here because indeed it is very important to remember that we're doing batch learning.
cues.zh: 我想特別強調這個超參數，是因為要記住，我們使用批次學習。

cues.en: Okay, so batch size equal 32, and finally, I'm sure you know which final parameter we have to enter here.
cues.zh: 所以 batch_size=32。最後，你應該知道還要填哪個參數。

cues.en: That's of course the number of epics.
cues.zh: 當然是 epoch 數量。

cues.en: You know, a neural network has to be trained over a certain amount of epics so has to improve the accuracy over time.
cues.zh: 神經網路需要訓練一定數量的 epoch，準確率才會隨訓練改善。

cues.en: And we will clearly see that once we execute this cell.
cues.zh: 執行儲存格後，就能清楚看到。

cues.en: So the name of the parameter for the number of epics is simply epics.
cues.zh: 指定訓練週期數的參數名稱就是 epochs。

cues.en: And while you will see that, it'll go very fast.
cues.zh: 你會看到，執行速度很快。

cues.en: So we can just take 100 epics.
cues.zh: 所以可以直接設成 100 個 epoch。

cues.en: But once again, feel free to choose another number as long as it is not too small, because you know your new network needs a certain amount of epics in order to learn properly, you know
cues.zh: 當然，也可以選其他數量，只要不要太少，因為神經網路需要一定的訓練週期，才能適當學習，

cues.en: learn the correlations to get the ultimate best predictions.
cues.zh: 學到資料間的關聯，得到更好的預測。

cues.en: All right, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So we're actually done with part three now.
cues.zh: 第三部分其實已經完成了。

cues.en: So I suggest we no longer wait and that we execute all the cells we haven't executed so far which I think you know, start from part two, right?
cues.zh: 不要再等，開始執行尚未執行的儲存格，應該是從第二部分開始。

cues.en: Yes. This was the last cell of the data pre processing phase.
cues.zh: 對，這是資料前處理最後一個儲存格。

cues.en: It was run properly.
cues.zh: 它已經正常執行。

cues.en: So let's actually run each cell one by one and see what we're gonna get in the end during the training.
cues.zh: 現在逐一執行，看看訓練過程會得到什麼結果。

cues.en: So let's start with this one.
cues.zh: 先從這一個開始。

cues.en: Initializing the A and N.
cues.zh: 初始化 ANN。

cues.en: Good. Now this one adding the input layer and the first hidden layer.
cues.zh: 很好，接著加入輸入層與第一個隱藏層。

cues.en: Good. Now this one, adding the second hidden layer.
cues.zh: 再加入第二個隱藏層。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 都沒有問題。

cues.en: And now this one, adding the output layer.
cues.zh: 現在加入輸出層。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 也沒有問題。

cues.en: Still. Now we enter part three, executing first this cell compiling the A and N.
cues.zh: 接著進入第三部分，先執行編譯 ANN 的儲存格。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 一切正常。

cues.en: And now are you ready, my friends?
cues.zh: 各位朋友，準備好了嗎？

cues.en: We're about to train the artificial neural network on the training set over 100 Epic.
cues.zh: 即將用訓練集訓練人工神經網路，共 100 個 epoch。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 開始了。

cues.en: The training is starting and as I told you, it's going pretty fast.
cues.zh: 訓練開始，和我說的一樣，速度很快。

cues.en: But look at this, look at the accuracy and how it is evolving over the epics.
cues.zh: 看看 accuracy，如何隨 epoch 變化。

cues.en: And we can see that it is actually increasing pretty fast.
cues.zh: 可以看到準確率上升得相當快。

cues.en: And mostly we see that it is actually converging, you know converging pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 而且很快開始收斂。

cues.en: You know, we converged at 0.86, you know at about the 20th Epic.
cues.zh: 大約第 20 個 epoch，就收斂在 0.86 左右。

cues.en: We actually did need that 100 Epic, but 20 was fine.
cues.zh: 其實不需要 100 個 epoch，20 個就已經不錯了。

cues.en: But anyway, you know, it's going really fast and I'm sure it's very over soon now, because indeed, yes there we go.
cues.zh: 不過反正速度很快，應該馬上就完成。確實如此。

cues.en: The training was done in more or less 20 seconds.
cues.zh: 訓練大約花了 20 秒。

cues.en: And the final accuracy we get on the training set we'll have to check the same on the test set is averaging around 0.86.
cues.zh: 最後訓練集準確率平均在 0.86 左右；之後還要在測試集確認。

cues.en: That's really good.
cues.zh: 這很不錯。

cues.en: That means that out of 100 observations you have 86 correct predictions.
cues.zh: 表示每 100 筆觀測值，大約有 86 筆預測正確。

cues.en: So congratulations you made a very good first deep learning model.
cues.zh: 恭喜，第一個深度學習模型的表現很好。

cues.en: You can be proud of yourself.
cues.zh: 你可以為自己感到自豪。

cues.en: And mostly now you can take a little break because we're gonna enter part four.
cues.zh: 現在可以稍作休息，因為接下來要進入第四部分。

cues.en: And not only we're gonna enter part four but also you're gonna see that you're gonna have a little homework which will consist of predicting the result of a single observation meaning a single customer.
cues.zh: 不只如此，還有一個小作業，要預測單一觀測值，也就是單一客戶的結果。

cues.en: You'll have to predict if this customer will stay in or leave the bank.
cues.zh: 判斷這位客戶會留下還是離開銀行。

cues.en: You will enter your solution here and we will implement the solution together in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 把你的解答放在這裡，下一堂會一起實作。

cues.en: So make sure to do it.
cues.zh: 記得動手做。

cues.en: Please try at least to do it.
cues.zh: 請至少試試看。

cues.en: You actually know how to do it because we already learned how to do a single prediction before you know, a prediction of a single observation.
cues.zh: 其實你已經知道怎麼做，因為之前學過如何預測單筆觀測值。

cues.en: So you have everything.
cues.zh: 需要的知識都有了。

cues.en: Maybe check out again part three classification if you have a doubt.
cues.zh: 如果不確定，再回頭看看第三部分分類。

cues.en: But there you go, that's your homework.
cues.zh: 這就是你的作業。

cues.en: You have to use our A and N model to predict if the customer with the following informations will leave the bank yes or no.
cues.zh: 用 ANN 模型，判斷具有以下資訊的客戶是否會離開銀行。

cues.en: And these following informations are that it is a French customer with a credit score of 600, a male one.
cues.zh: 這是一位法國男性客戶，信用評分為 600。

cues.en: He is 40 years old, He has been in the bank for three years.
cues.zh: 年齡 40 歲，與銀行往來三年。

cues.en: He has $60,000 in his account.
cues.zh: 帳戶餘額是 60,000 美元。

cues.en: He has two products in the bank.
cues.zh: 使用兩項銀行產品。

cues.en: He has a credit card, indeed, he is also an active member and he has an estimated salary of $50,000.
cues.zh: 有信用卡，也是活躍會員，估計薪資為 50,000 美元。

cues.en: And the question is so should we say goodbye to that customer?
cues.zh: 問題是，我們該不該準備向這位客戶道別？

cues.en: Well please figure it out and we will see if you're right in the next tutorial.
